title: Identification of Functional Genetic Components Modulating Toxicity Response to PFOS using Genome-wide CRISPR Screens in HepG2/C3A cells
model: HepG2/C3A liver cells, genome-wide Brunello-style KO
contrast: PFOS 192 uM (10 doublings) vs control (3 vs 3)
paper_calls: 340 candidate genes (189 sensitizers, 151 resistance); SLC6A9 and CPSF2 validated
named_hits: SLC6A9 #9 of enriched (empirical FDR 0.13); CPSF2 not recovered
verdict: Raw reads recovered exactly from the MAGeCK-normalized table. BARCS is far more conservative than the paper's 340-gene list: no gene passes FDR 0.10, though the validated resistance gene SLC6A9 ranks near the top of enriched genes.
count_recovery: Raw reads = normalized / (one scale factor per sample); integrality 100.0% at k=1.
